summary.text: Gary Brewer is a Republican business executive who has represented District 114 in the South Carolina House of Representatives since November 14, 2022, and he is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Gary Brewer was born in Summerville, South Carolina, and lives in West Ashley.

His career experience includes work as vice president of construction services at HDR Engineering, director of business development at Banks Construction Company, and marketing manager with Knights Companies.
Brewer succeeded Lin Bennett as the District 114 representative.
For 2025-2026 he is assigned to the Labor, Commerce and Industry Committee.
